subject: Changes in the upcoming version of Shiny

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Changes in the upcoming version of Shiny
parts:
Hi everyone -

The upcoming version of Shiny has some big changes under the hood. The biggest change is that Shiny is switching from the Bootstrap 2 web framework to the next version, Bootstrap 3. This is in part because Bootstrap 2 is no longer being developed, and in part because it allows us to tap into the ecosystem of Bootstrap 3 themes. We've packaged up some themes in the shinythemes package.


If you'd like to test it out, you can install the development version with:
  devtools::install_github('rstudio/shiny')


For most users, the transition should be seamless, but it's possible you'll run into issues. I'm compiling a list of potential issues for migration here:
  http://rpubs.com/wch/47880


If you encounter other issues, please let us know on this mailing list, or on the Shiny issue tracker. This will help us to make the transition as smooth as possible for Shiny users.

Thanks for your help!
-Winston
